summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with altered mental status and respiratory failure following a drug overdose involving benzodiazepines, opiates, and cocaine. He was intubated for airway protection and managed in the ICU with supportive care, including IV hydralazine for hypertension and antibiotics for suspected UTI. Toxicology and psychiatry consultations indicated a non-suicidal mixed ingestion. He was successfully extubated on hospital day two, completed a course of antibiotics, and stabilized medically. His chronic conditions, including CKD, neurogenic bladder, and seizure disorder, were managed without complication. He was discharged home with simplified medications, a short course of oral nitrofurantoin, and referrals for psychiatry, substance use counseling, and primary care follow-up.
